AI / Machine Learning Engineer:
Position: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
Company: QuantumTech AI Labs
Location: Remote / Bengaluru

Job Overview:
We are seeking a talented and driven Machine Learning Engineer to join our Applied AI team. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade deep learning models, natural language processing (NLP) pipelines, and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and fine-tune NLP and Deep Learning models using PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and Scikit-learn.
- Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using LangChain, Vector Databases, and Python.
- Implement end-to-end MLOps pipelines with Docker, MLflow, and CI/CD for continuous model training and deployment.
- Collaborate with backend engineers to deploy REST APIs using FastAPI and containerized microservices on AWS.
- Conduct statistical analysis and feature engineering on massive structured and unstructured datasets using Pandas and NumPy.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related STEM field.
- 1-3 years of hands-on experience or substantial project experience in Python, PyTorch, and NLP.
- Strong proficiency in SQL, Git, and Docker.
- Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Clean Architecture.
- Demonstrated ability in Problem Solving and Effective Communication in cross-functional teams.

Data Scientist:

Company: InsightMetrics Analytics
Location: Remote
